title: AI Sales Enablement & Coaching
tagline: Turn sales calls into coaching and battlecards: vector search over transcripts, per-call metrics with coaching flags and rep trends, and competitor battlecards built from real objections and playbook answers.
why: Every sales team records its calls, and almost nobody listens to them. The value is in three questions. Where did a buyer say X? Is this rep getting better? What do we say when a competitor comes up? An LLM can draft the answers, but the facts must come from the transcript, with timestamps, so a manager can check them in ten seconds. This repo is the retrieval and metrics layer an LLM summary would stand on.
covers: TF-IDF vector index over utterance windows, cosine ranking, overlap suppression, call / speaker / timestamp on each hit
Per-call coaching: rep talk %, rep questions, longest monologue in seconds, topic hits with timestamps, next steps found
Coaching flags against targets (talk ratio, questions, monologue, no next step) and a 0–100 call score
Rep trend across calls: talk % and questions first vs last call, improving yes / no
Battlecards: competitor aliases, mentions, win rate when mentioned, objections in the same or next utterance, playbook response and proof, verbatim quotes
gaps: No Gong / Chorus API connection: transcripts are synthetic JSON; competitor names are fictional
Vectors are TF-IDF, not neural embeddings; the index is rebuilt per request
No LLM summarization call: the outputs here are the cited facts a summary prompt would use

ops.label: Transcript search
ops.help: Search three synthetic calls for a phrase. Each hit has the call, timestamp and two utterances of context.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Thanks for the time. Let me walk you through our platform, we have routing, scoring, enrichment, dashboards and a full AI layer on top, and customers love it because it replaces four tools.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: We also integrate with Salesforce and HubSpot, and setup is usually two weeks, and the pricing is per seat with volume discounts.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: We are also looking at QuotaPilot. Their quote was cheaper per seat.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Sure. Any other questions?

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Our security team will need a SOC 2 report before any review.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Got it, I can look into it.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Before I show anything, what made you take this call now?

utterances.speaker: Lee
utterances.text: Our SDRs miss hot accounts. Leads sit for two days before anyone calls.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: How are leads routed today? Who owns the rules?

utterances.speaker: Lee
utterances.text: RevOps owns them in Salesforce, but it is a mess of flows.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: What does a missed hot account cost you in a quarter?

utterances.speaker: Lee
utterances.text: Probably three or four deals. We tried RivalCRM's add-on but the integration broke every sync.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: What would good look like in 90 days? Who else needs to sign off?

utterances.speaker: Lee
utterances.text: Under ten minutes to first touch. Our CFO signs anything over fifty thousand.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Makes sense. Next step: I'll send a two-page plan by Friday and let's schedule a 30-minute session with your CFO next week?

utterances.speaker: Lee
utterances.text: Yes, book it for Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: What changed since our last call? Where did the pilot land?

utterances.speaker: Kim
utterances.text: The pilot worked, but QuotaPilot came back with a lower price and a free onboarding package.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: What did the pilot save your team per week? How did you measure it?

utterances.speaker: Kim
utterances.text: About 12 hours of manual routing a week. Security asked about data residency too.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Is price the only open item, or is the residency question a blocker?

utterances.speaker: Kim
utterances.text: Residency is a blocker for legal. Price is second.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Understood. I'll send our EU residency doc today. Can we review it with legal on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Kim
utterances.text: Thursday works. Loop in our legal lead.

ops.label: Coach calls
ops.help: Measure each call against coaching targets and show the rep's trend from first call to last.

ops.label: Battlecards
ops.help: Build one battlecard per competitor from the calls, with the objections buyers raised and the playbook answer.

price.response: Compare cost per routed hot account, not cost per seat. Show the pilot's hours saved times loaded cost.

integration.response: Native bi-directional sync with field-level conflict rules; show the sync log in the demo.

onboarding.response: Fixed 14-day onboarding with a named engineer; offer a success plan instead of a discount.
